# Gino's Gelato Repository Instructions

Before making architectural or repository-wide changes, follow:

[Project Vision](../docs/ai/00-Project-Vision.md)

Core requirements:

- React and TypeScript frontend
- ASP.NET Core API
- Azure SQL
- Azure Key Vault
- Managed Identity
- Bicep
- GitHub Actions with OIDC
- No secrets in source control
- No unnecessary distributed architecture
- Validate builds and tests before declaring work complete
